patterns.note: Content is organized into full-width, distinctively color-blocked sections, often using vibrant gradients as backgrounds.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and uppercase sans-serif, creating a strong, declarative voice.
The site heavily utilizes a vibrant, multi-stop linear gradient system for full-bleed section backgrounds, transitioning between warm and cool tones.

The main 'INCLUSIVE DISTRICT' title and crown graphic perform a complex scroll-triggered animation: they start as a hero overlay, then stick to the top of the viewport, and finally scale down and reposition into the footer as the user scrolls to the bottom.
Each major content block is visually separated by a unique, full-width gradient background, creating clear visual breaks and a dynamic flow.

technique_notes: Implement a full-bleed hero image with a semi-transparent overlay for text contrast, allowing the vibrant background to show through.
Utilize a sticky navigation bar that remains at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
Create scroll-triggered parallax effects for hero elements, where the background image moves slower than foreground text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (hero title is ~5-6x body text) with smaller, often uppercase labels and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with an airy hero section and clear, distinct spacing between full-width content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic interaction of the 'INCLUSIVE DISTRICT' title and crown graphic. It starts as a hero overlay, then sticks to the top of the viewport, and finally scales down and repositions itself as a permanent part of the footer, creating a strong brand anchor throughout the scroll experience. The vibrant, multi-color gradient section backgrounds also contribute to its unique, playful aesthetic.
